outcome: density of fibroblasts in the cervix
density of inflammatory cells (neutrophils, mononuclear cells) in the cervix
cohort: Pregnant individuals categorized into groups of spontaneous preterm labour (n=14), term labour (n=14), and a small set of preterm not in labour (n=6), from whom cervical biopsies were obtained.
finding: The study found significantly higher inflammation, particularly neutrophils and mononuclear cells, in the exocervix of individuals in preterm labour compared to term labour, with neutrophils also significantly decreased in preterm individuals not in labour.
cross-section timing: At the time of cervical biopsy, corresponding to the labour status (preterm labour, term labour, or preterm not in labour).
